frequency_question: How often do such wartime domestic defense production initiatives successfully establish operational status and receive public independent verification within the stipulated timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes state-level attempts to localize licensed production of advanced guided munitions or aircraft with foreign tech transfer during active conflict; excludes routine peacetime procurement or purely domestic unassisted designs.

cases.name: Ukraine Neptune missile domestic serial production setup
Ukraine Vilkha rocket system domestic production transition
Taiwan Hsiung Feng III production scaling during regional tensions
Iran Noor/Qader cruise missile localized manufacturing lines
Pakistan Babur cruise missile domestic integration and assembly line
India-Russia BrahMos joint venture manufacturing facility setup in Hyderabad

coverage_note: 6 named cases; representative of modern asymmetric or wartime joint-venture high-tech missile localization.
known_gaps: Classified bilateral transfers between hidden partners are omitted due to lack of reputable public reporting confirmation.
skeleton: Total historical wartime or emergency tech-transfer aerospace manufacturing attempts meeting criteria vs those failing due to technical/supply chain friction before public confirmation.
multiplier: 5 hits / 6 total cases evaluated from comparable tech-transfer defense localization efforts under duress.
validity_reason: Defense industrial base localization dynamics and rapid wartime innovation cycles remain stable across geopolitical conflicts through the end of the decade.
